description: README.md's '## CLI' table documents every tether subcommand and its flags (init, init claude-code, add, status with --json/--diff, show, coverage with --list-untethered-files/--list-tethered-files/--json, refresh, update, mv, rm) that are defined as click commands in tether/cli.py. Adding, removing, or renaming a subcommand, or changing its arguments/flags in cli.py, must update the README CLI table.
